text: Program Description 1. Course Objectives Editor Notes: The programme aims to help international students to become qualified medical professionals through six years of training in the medical school and hospitals. XMU is one of the Chinese universities authorized by China's Ministry of Education to enroll international students in the MBBS programe instructed in English. XMU launched the MBBS programme in 2006 and the number of graduates who have passed the Indian Medical License Examination comes first among comparable Chinese universities. Students shall conduct their internships in the 6th year with a duration of at least 48 weeks. 2. Teaching Organizations Editor Notes: XMU owns 9 departments and research centres, 5 affiliated hospitals, 5 teaching hospitals as well as 4 teaching bases. 9 departments and research centres basic medical department clinical medical department preventive medical department Chinese medical department pharmaceutical department and nursing department scientific research organizations of biomedical engineering research center anticancer research center basic medical experimental and teaching center Chinese Medicine research center of Xiamen University etc. 5 grade three plus affiliated hospitals Affiliated Sun Yat-sen Hospital Affiliated Southeast Hospital Affiliated Xiamen Ophthalmic Hospital etc. 5 teaching hospitals Xiamen 1st Hospital Xiamen 2nd Hospital Xiamen Chinese Medical Hospital Xiamen Xianyue Hospital Xiamen Maternity and Child Health Hospital 4 teaching bases Xiamen Disease Prevention and Control Center Xiamen Hygiene Supervision Institute Xiamen Drug Examination Institute Xiamen Starshark Drug Company 3. Introduction to XMU Editor Notes: Xiamen University was the first university in China founded by an overseas Chinese. Xiamen University is one of China's most prestigious higher-learning institutions, enjoying privileged support from both the nation's "211 Project" and the "985 Project". XMU's campuses are nestled snugly between green hills and the blue sea, earning the reputation as one of the most beautiful universities in China. Currently, Professor Zhu Chongshi is the President of the University and Professor Zhang Yan is the Chairman of the University Council. 4. A Brief Introduction to Xiamen Edoitor Notes: Xiamen is the second largest city in Fujian province. Xiamen is one of the five earliest special economic zones, obtaining large amount of investment from Taiwan and Hong Kong. As an industrial powerhouse, Xiamen also preserves its charm with incomparable sightseeings, good food, some great architecture and a mild to hot climate. As a popular international tourist destination, Xiamen has received the "Nations in Bloom" Award and the UN Habitat Scroll of Honor Award. 5. International exchange and cooperation Edoitor Notes: Worldwide exchanges and cooperations offer studnets in XMU easy acess to famous institutes and universities. The University has established partnerships with over 280 institutions of higher education worldwide. In addition, XMU operates 16 Confucius Institutes around the world, which are playing a significant role in promoting cultural exchanges between China and the rest of the world. 6. Faculty Edoitor Notes: XMU has a strong faculty of teaching departments and research institutes and centres. Xiamen University has recruited a significant number of top-notch faculty members from throughout the world, including many prominent scientists and leading scholars. The University currently boasts a highly qualified faculty of 2,703, of which 1,766 or 65.3% are professors or associate professors and 1,918 or 71.8% are PhDs. 7. First-class facilities Edoitor Notes: XMU boast a comprehensive range of teaching and research facilities and an efficient public service system. Xiamen University has a collection of over four million volumes and 4.43 million volumes of e-books. XMU has one of the most sophisticated high-speed information networks among Chinese higher-learning institutions. 8. Colourful campus life Edoitor Notes: XMU organizes a variety of social and sports as well as cultural activities for international students.
